program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((objs (sort (objects g 0)
                     (lambda (a b)
                       (> (* (obj-h a) (obj-w a)) (* (obj-h b) (obj-w b)))))))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)])
              ([obj (in-list objs)]
               [i (in-naturals 0)])
      (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) (+ 2 i)))))
